ad.title: App data spot
ad.hint: Every app keeps its stuff in one folder on the data disk — one folder per app, no chaos.
ad.off: Docker’s not here, so no App data folder rn.
ad.root.label: App data folder
ad.root.hint: Moving pauses the apps using it, copies + double-checks every file, points them at the new folder and starts them back up. The old copy sticks around till you yeet it.
ad.root.confirmText: Apps using {from} take a nap while their files get copied to {to} and checked. They wake up after. Old copy stays till you remove it.
ad.root.fail: Couldn’t move the App data folder
ad.oldRoot.label: Old copy
ad.oldRoot.hint: App data moved out. The old copy is still chilling at {path}.
ad.oldRoot.confirmText: Everything in {path} is gone for good. No undo, fr.
ad.share.title: App data share
ad.share.hint: Open the App data folder from another computer over the network.
ad.share.toggleHint: Admins only. File Sharing (SMB) has to be on.
ad.share.warn: Saved, but the share didn’t update yet
ad.organize.title: Apps still on Docker volumes
ad.organize.hint: Move them into the App data folder so each one gets its own folder you can open in Files.
ad.cands.title: {n} app(s) still stash data in Docker volumes
ad.cands.hint: Move them into {root}, one folder each. Nothing moves till you say so.
ad.move.confirmText: {app} pauses while its files get copied to {dirs} and checked, then comes back on the folders. If anything flops it goes back to its volumes. The volumes stay till you clean up.
ad.all.confirmText: One at a time, each app pauses, gets copied into {root}, checked and restarted. Any app that flops goes back to its volumes.
ad.job.done: Done. Old volumes stay till you clean them up in Settings → Containers.
ad.old.title: Clean up old volumes
ad.old.hint: Volumes left over after apps moved into App data.
ad.old.confirmText: They take up {size}. The apps already use their App data folders. No undo.
ad.spec.hint: New folders land in the App data folder ({root}) by default.
ad.uninstall.title: Delete {app}’s data?
ad.uninstall.text: Its App data folder (settings, databases, files) is gone for good. Type {id} to confirm.
ad.backup.label: App data
ad.backup.hint: Every app’s folder in the App data folder
ad.backup.stopHint: Databases get copied clean; apps are offline while it runs
